title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
source: Lineage: Source 1 SBD > MSR > C > DAT (Biodtl thru O1(7:27); Source 2 MR > Revox A77 > tube pre (O1@7:27 thru Lovelight); Transfer info: Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the post‑New Orleans benefit show with a smoking Lovelight featuring Jerry and Peter Green plus a raging Other One, though the mix is a bit rough at the very start.
ai_review.review: The performance shines thanks to an epic Lovelight where Jerry trades licks with guest guitarist Peter Green and a ferocious Other One that many reviewers call a rager. While the first couple of tunes suffer from a wonky mix (Bob’s guitar too forward), the rest of the set settles into a clear, well‑balanced soundboard recording that lets Pigpen’s 40‑minute Lovelight dominate the evening.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 5 stars) praise the musical moments, and while there are minor mix issues at the start, the overall soundboard quality is solid, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early part of the show has a muddy mix with Bob Weir too high in the levels; after that the soundboard is clear and balances Pigpen’s vocals and instruments well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Benefit show stretches out with a late‑night Lovelight that adds length; stage banter is lively and the set flows naturally despite a brief, rough opening.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Trades licks with guest Peter Green during Lovelight; tone praised as perfect.
band_member_comments.Phil: Riffs a brief Dark Star segment before it cuts off; noted for his improvisational spark.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mix is too forward on the first few tunes, but otherwise contributes solid rhythm work.
